```{r}
# SHA imputation for Pattern B, Sensor 4 both directions

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)

set.seed(42)

# Read data
groundtruth <- read_csv("MICE_wide_1jamnew.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
missing_df  <- read_csv("patternB_curated_blackouts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

#Time Features
prep_time <- function(dat) {
  temp_time <- parse_date_time(
  dat$Timestamp,
  orders = c("dmy HM", "dmy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS"),
  tz = "UTC"
)


  if (any(is.na(temp_time))) {
    warning("Some timestamps could not be parsed. Check date format.")
  }

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      Timestamp = format(temp_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      DayOfWeek = as.factor(as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%u")) - 1),
      Hour = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%H")),
      Minute = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%M"))
    )
}

groundtruth <- prep_time(groundtruth)
missing_df  <- prep_time(missing_df)

target_cols <- c( "Vol_S4_dir_a", "Spd_S4_dir_a","Vol_S4_dir_b", "Spd_S4_dir_b")


cat("Target columns:", length(target_cols), "\n")
cat("Total missing cells:", sum(is.na(missing_df[target_cols])), "\n")

# SHA function
sha_impute <- function(df, col) {
  
  s1 <- df %>%
    group_by(DayOfWeek, Hour, Minute) %>%
    summarise(v1 = mean(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  s2 <- df %>%
    group_by(Hour, Minute) %>%
    summarise(v2 = mean(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  s3 <- df %>%
    group_by(DayOfWeek, Hour) %>%
    summarise(v3 = mean(.data[[col]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  overall <- mean(df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  temp <- df %>%
    left_join(s1, by = c("DayOfWeek", "Hour", "Minute")) %>%
    left_join(s2, by = c("Hour", "Minute")) %>%
    left_join(s3, by = c("DayOfWeek", "Hour"))
  
  x <- ifelse(
    is.na(temp[[col]]),
    coalesce(temp$v1, temp$v2, temp$v3, overall),
    temp[[col]]
  )
  
  if (grepl("^Vol_", col)) x <- round(pmax(x, 0))
  if (grepl("^Spd_", col)) x <- round(pmax(x, 0), 1)
  
  df[[col]] <- x
  df
}

# Apply SHA
sha_imputed <- missing_df

for (col in target_cols) {
  if (any(is.na(sha_imputed[[col]]))) {
    sha_imputed <- sha_impute(sha_imputed, col)
  }
}

write_csv(sha_imputed, "traffic_wide_SHA_patternB.csv")

cat("Remaining missing cells:", sum(is.na(sha_imputed[target_cols])), "\n")

# Error metrics and empirical error uncertainty
rmse <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((b - a)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae  <- function(a, b) mean(abs(b - a), na.rm = TRUE)

get_metrics <- function(col) {
  
  rows <- is.na(missing_df[[col]]) & !is.na(groundtruth[[col]])
  
  truth <- groundtruth[[col]][rows]
  pred  <- sha_imputed[[col]][rows]
  error <- pred - truth
  
  data.frame(
    Variable = col,
    Sensor_ID = 4,
    Direction = ifelse(grepl("dir_a", col), "dir_a", "dir_b"),
    Type = ifelse(grepl("^Vol_", col), "Volume", "Speed"),
    Missing_Cells = sum(rows),
    RMSE = rmse(truth, pred),
    MAE = mae(truth, pred),
    Bias = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Error_SD = sd(error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Upper_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

get_overall_metrics <- function(cols, type_name) {
  
  truth_all <- c()
  pred_all  <- c()
  
  for (col in cols) {
    
    rows <- is.na(missing_df[[col]]) & !is.na(groundtruth[[col]])
    
    truth_all <- c(truth_all, groundtruth[[col]][rows])
    pred_all  <- c(pred_all, sha_imputed[[col]][rows])
  }
  
  error <- pred_all - truth_all
  
  data.frame(
    Variable = paste0("Overall_", type_name),
    Sensor_ID = 4,
    Direction = "dir_a + dir_b",
    Type = type_name,
    Missing_Cells = length(truth_all),
    RMSE = rmse(truth_all, pred_all),
    MAE = mae(truth_all, pred_all),
    Bias = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Error_SD = sd(error, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    Upper_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

volume_cols <- c("Vol_S4_dir_a", "Vol_S4_dir_b")
speed_cols  <- c("Spd_S4_dir_a", "Spd_S4_dir_b")

sha_metrics <- bind_rows(
  lapply(target_cols, get_metrics),
  get_overall_metrics(volume_cols, "Volume"),
  get_overall_metrics(speed_cols, "Speed")
) %>%
  arrange(Type, Variable)

write_csv(sha_metrics, "sha_metrics_patternB.csv")
print(sha_metrics)




# Total Miles Travelled
vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(sha_imputed), value = TRUE)

link_miles <- rep(5, length(vol_cols))
names(link_miles) <- vol_cols

tmt <- function(df, cols = vol_cols) {
  sum(sapply(cols, function(col) {
    sum(df[[col]] * link_miles[col], na.rm = TRUE)
  }))
}

tmt_results <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Groundtruth", "Missing", "SHA_Imputed"),
  Total_Miles_Travelled = c(
    tmt(groundtruth),
    tmt(missing_df),
    tmt(sha_imputed)
  )
) 
  

write_csv(tmt_results, "sha_tmt_results_patternB.csv")
print(tmt_results)
```

```{r}
#Time Featured

sha_impute <- function(df, col) {

# Error metrics
rmse <- function(a, b) sqrt(mean((b - a)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae  <- function(a, b) mean(abs(b - a), na.rm = TRUE)

# Empty lists to store aggregated results across all 10 datasets
all_sha_metrics <- list()
all_tmt_results <- list()

for (run in 1:TOTAL_RUNS) {
  
  
  cat("STARTING SHA DATASET RUN:", run, "OUT OF", TOTAL_RUNS, "\n")
  
  
  # Read data for the current run
  truth_file <- paste0("MICE_wide_1jamnew_", run, ".csv")
  miss_file  <- paste0("patternB_curated_blackouts_", run, ".csv")
  
  groundtruth <- read_csv(truth_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  missing_df  <- read_csv(miss_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  groundtruth <- prep_time(groundtruth)
  missing_df  <- prep_time(missing_df)
  
  target_cols <- c("Vol_S4_dir_a", "Spd_S4_dir_a", "Vol_S4_dir_b", "Spd_S4_dir_b"  )
  
  # Apply SHA
  sha_imputed <- missing_df
  
  for (col in target_cols) {
    if (any(is.na(sha_imputed[[col]]))) {
      sha_imputed <- sha_impute(sha_imputed, col)
    }
  }
  
  # Export individual imputed dataset with Run ID
  write_csv(sha_imputed, paste0("traffic_wide_SHA_patternB_run", run, ".csv"))
  
  # Helper function for individual metrics
  get_metrics <- function(col) {
    rows <- is.na(missing_df[[col]]) & !is.na(groundtruth[[col]])
    
    truth <- groundtruth[[col]][rows]
    pred  <- sha_imputed[[col]][rows]
    error <- pred - truth
    
    data.frame(
      Variable = col,
      Sensor_ID = 4,
      Direction = ifelse(grepl("dir_a", col), "dir_a", "dir_b"),
      Type = ifelse(grepl("^Vol_", col), "Volume", "Speed"),
      Missing_Cells = sum(rows),
      RMSE = rmse(truth, pred),
      MAE = mae(truth, pred),
      Bias = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
      Error_SD = sd(error, na.rm = TRUE),
      Lower_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
      Upper_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  }
  
  # Helper function for overall metrics
  get_overall_metrics <- function(cols, type_name) {
    truth_all <- c()
    pred_all  <- c()
    
    for (col in cols) {
      rows <- is.na(missing_df[[col]]) & !is.na(groundtruth[[col]])
      truth_all <- c(truth_all, groundtruth[[col]][rows])
      pred_all  <- c(pred_all, sha_imputed[[col]][rows])
    }
    
    error <- pred_all - truth_all
    
    data.frame(
      Variable = paste0("Overall_", type_name),
      Sensor_ID = 4,
      Direction = "dir_a + dir_b",
      Type = type_name,
      Missing_Cells = length(truth_all),
      RMSE = rmse(truth_all, pred_all),
      MAE = mae(truth_all, pred_all),
      Bias = mean(error, na.rm = TRUE),
      Error_SD = sd(error, na.rm = TRUE),
      Lower_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
      Upper_95_Error = unname(quantile(error, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  }
  
  volume_cols <- c("Vol_S4_dir_a", "Vol_S4_dir_b")
  speed_cols  <- c("Spd_S4_dir_a", "Spd_S4_dir_b")
  
  sha_metrics <- bind_rows(
    lapply(target_cols, get_metrics),
    get_overall_metrics(volume_cols, "Volume"),
    get_overall_metrics(speed_cols, "Speed")
  ) %>%
    arrange(Type, Variable) %>%
    mutate(Dataset_Run = run, .before = 1)
  
  all_sha_metrics[[run]] <- sha_metrics
  
  # Total Miles Travelled
  vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(sha_imputed), value = TRUE)
  link_miles <- rep(5, length(vol_cols))
  names(link_miles) <- vol_cols
  
  tmt <- function(df, cols = vol_cols) {
    sum(sapply(cols, function(col) {
      sum(df[[col]] * link_miles[col], na.rm = TRUE)
    }))
  }
  
  tmt_results <- data.frame(
    Dataset_Run = run,
    Dataset = c("Groundtruth", "Missing", "SHA_Imputed"),
    Total_Miles_Travelled = c(
      tmt(groundtruth),
      tmt(missing_df),
      tmt(sha_imputed)
    )
  ) 
  
  all_tmt_results[[run]] <- tmt_results
}


cat("ALL RUNS COMPLETE. EXPORTING MASTER SUMMARY FILES.\n")
```

```{r}
# MICE-PMM for Pattern B: Sensor 4 blackout, both directions

library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)


set.seed(42)

# Files
truth <- read_csv("MICE_wide_1jamnew.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
miss  <- read_csv("patternB_curated_blackouts.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

M <- 5
MAXIT <- 5

# Link lengths for all sensors
link_miles <- c(
  S1 = 5, S2 = 5, S3 = 5, S4 = 5, S5 = 5,
  S6 = 5, S7 = 5, S8 = 5, S9 = 5, S10 = 5
)

# Time features
prep <- function(dat) {
  temp_time <- parse_date_time(
  dat$Timestamp,
  orders = c("dmy HM", "dmy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS"),
  tz = "UTC"
)


  if (any(is.na(temp_time))) {
    warning("Some timestamps could not be parsed. Check date format.")
  }

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      Timestamp = format(temp_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      Date = as.Date(temp_time),
      DayOfWeek = as.factor(as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%u")) - 1),
      Hour = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%H")),
      Minute = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%M")),
      TimeOfDay = Hour * 60 + Minute,
      Time_sin = sin(2 * pi * TimeOfDay / 1440),
      Time_cos = cos(2 * pi * TimeOfDay / 1440)

    )
}



truth <- prep(truth)
miss  <- prep(miss)

original_cols <- names(miss)

target_vars <- c("Vol_S4_dir_a", "Spd_S4_dir_a","Vol_S4_dir_b", "Spd_S4_dir_b")

target_vars <- target_vars[target_vars %in% names(miss)]#safety  check

target_vars <- target_vars[sapply(miss[target_vars], function(x) any(is.na(x)))] #another safety check

if (length(target_vars) == 0) {
  stop("No missing values found in Sensor 4 Pattern B variables.")
}

cat("Variables to impute:", paste(target_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Predictor variables
candidate_predictors <- c(
  "DayOfWeek", "Time_sin", "Time_cos",

  "Vol_S1_dir_a", "Vol_S2_dir_a", "Vol_S3_dir_a", "Vol_S7_dir_a",
  "Spd_S1_dir_a", "Spd_S2_dir_a", "Spd_S3_dir_a", "Spd_S7_dir_a",

  "Vol_S1_dir_b", "Vol_S2_dir_b", "Vol_S3_dir_b", "Vol_S7_dir_b",
  "Spd_S1_dir_b", "Spd_S2_dir_b", "Spd_S3_dir_b", "Spd_S7_dir_b",

  "Vol_S5_dir_a", "Vol_S6_dir_a", "Vol_S5_dir_b", "Vol_S6_dir_b",
  "Spd_S5_dir_a", "Spd_S6_dir_a", "Spd_S5_dir_b", "Spd_S6_dir_b"
)

predictors <- candidate_predictors[candidate_predictors %in% names(miss)] #safety check

# Remove ID columns before MICE
id_cols <- c("Timestamp", "Day_Name", "Date")
id_cols <- id_cols[id_cols %in% names(miss)]

mice_data <- miss %>%
  select(-all_of(id_cols))

# MICE setup
ini <- mice(mice_data, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)

method <- ini$method
method[] <- ""
method[target_vars] <- "pmm"

pred <- ini$predictorMatrix
pred[,] <- 0

for (v in target_vars) {
  pred[v, predictors[predictors %in% colnames(pred)]] <- 1
  pred[v, setdiff(target_vars, v)] <- 1
  pred[v, v] <- 0
}

# Run MICE-PMM
imp <- mice(
  mice_data,
  m = M,
  maxit = MAXIT,
  method = method,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  donors = 3,
  seed = 42,
  printFlag = TRUE
)

plot(imp)

# Completed datasets
completed_list <- lapply(1:M, function(i) {
  dat <- complete(imp, i)
  dat <- bind_cols(miss[id_cols], dat)
  dat$Timestamp <- miss$Timestamp
 
  dat <- dat %>%
    select(-TimeOfDay, -Time_sin, -Time_cos)

  keep_cols <- original_cols[
    !original_cols %in% c("TimeOfDay","Time_sin", "Time_cos")
  ]
  
  dat <- dat[, keep_cols]

  vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
  spd_cols <- grep("^Spd_", names(dat), value = TRUE)

  dat[vol_cols] <- lapply(dat[vol_cols], function(x) round(pmax(x, 0)))
  dat[spd_cols] <- lapply(dat[spd_cols], function(x) round(pmax(x, 0), 1))

  dat
})

for (i in 1:M) {
  clean_export <- completed_list[[i]] %>% select(-any_of("Date"))
  write_csv(clean_export, paste0("patternB_MICE_PMM_imp", i, ".csv"))
}

# Pooled completed dataset
pooled <- completed_list[[1]]

for (v in target_vars) {
  pooled[[v]] <- rowMeans(sapply(completed_list, function(d) d[[v]]), na.rm = TRUE)

  observed <- !is.na(miss[[v]])
  pooled[[v]][observed] <- miss[[v]][observed] #safety measure

  if (grepl("^Vol_", v)) pooled[[v]] <- round(pmax(pooled[[v]], 0))
  if (grepl("^Spd_", v)) pooled[[v]] <- round(pmax(pooled[[v]], 0), 1)
}

pooled_export <- pooled %>% select(-any_of("Date"))
write_csv(pooled_export, "patternB_MICE_PMM_pooled.csv")

# Accuracy metrics
calc_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
  err <- pred - true

  tibble(
    RMSE = sqrt(mean(err^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE = mean(abs(err), na.rm = TRUE),
    Bias = mean(err, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

metrics_by_var <- bind_rows(lapply(target_vars, function(v) {
  rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

  calc_metrics(truth[[v]][rows], pooled[[v]][rows]) %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = v,
      N_missing = sum(rows),
      .before = 1
    )
}))

overall_volume <- bind_rows(lapply(grep("^Vol_", target_vars, value = TRUE), function(v) {
  rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])
  tibble(True = truth[[v]][rows], Imputed = pooled[[v]][rows])
}))

overall_speed <- bind_rows(lapply(grep("^Spd_", target_vars, value = TRUE), function(v) {
  rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])
  tibble(True = truth[[v]][rows], Imputed = pooled[[v]][rows])
}))

metrics_overall <- bind_rows(
  calc_metrics(overall_volume$True, overall_volume$Imputed) %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = "Overall_volume",
      N_missing = nrow(overall_volume),
      .before = 1
    ),

  calc_metrics(overall_speed$True, overall_speed$Imputed) %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = "Overall_speed",
      N_missing = nrow(overall_speed),
      .before = 1
    )
)

metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_by_var, metrics_overall)

write_csv(metrics, "patternB_RMSE_MAE_Bias.csv")
print(metrics)

# Comparison table for missing cells
comparison <- bind_rows(lapply(target_vars, function(v) {
  rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

  tibble(
    Timestamp = truth$Timestamp[rows],
    Variable = v,
    GroundTruth = truth[[v]][rows],
    Missing = miss[[v]][rows],
    Imputed = pooled[[v]][rows],
    Error = pooled[[v]][rows] - truth[[v]][rows]
  )
}))

write_csv(comparison, "patternB_groundtruth_missing_imputed.csv")

# Total Miles Travelled
# The target is the realised TMT in the fixed 90-day synthetic dataset. Therefore, each completed dataset has an exact TMT total and U^(k) = 0.

vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(miss), value = TRUE)

sensor_name <- function(x) {
  paste0("S", sub(".*_S([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", x))
}

calc_tmt <- function(dat, na.rm = FALSE) {
  row_tmt <- rep(0, nrow(dat))

  for (v in vol_cols) {
    s <- sensor_name(v)
    row_tmt <- row_tmt + dat[[v]] * link_miles[[s]]
  }

  if (!na.rm && any(is.na(row_tmt))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sum(row_tmt, na.rm = na.rm)
}

tmt_truth <- calc_tmt(truth)

# Descriptive value only. It is not used in Rubin's Rules.
tmt_missing_observed <- calc_tmt(miss, na.rm = TRUE)

# This cellwise pooled dataset is useful for reconstruction metrics.
tmt_pooled <- calc_tmt(pooled)

# One exact TMT total from each completed imputed dataset
tmt_imp_results <- tibble(
  Imputation = seq_len(M),
  Estimate = vapply(completed_list, calc_tmt, numeric(1))
)

tmt_summary <- tibble(
  Dataset = c( "GroundTruth", "Missing_observed_only", "MICE_PMM_pooled", paste0("Imp", 1:M)),
  TMT = c(
    tmt_truth,
    tmt_missing_observed,
    tmt_pooled,
    tmt_imp_results$Estimate
  )
)

write_csv(tmt_summary, "patternB_TMT.csv")
print(tmt_summary)

# Rubin's Rules for a fixed finite-population TMT target
rubin_pool_fixed_tmt <- function(estimates, conf_level = 0.95) {

  if (any(!is.finite(estimates))) {
    stop("All completed datasets must have a finite TMT estimate.")
  }

  m <- length(estimates)

  if (m < 2) {
    stop("At least two imputations are required to estimate between-imputation variance.")
  }

  q_bar <- mean(estimates)
  b <- var(estimates)

  # Fixed 90-day ground-truth TMT: complete-data within-imputation variance is zero.
  total_var <- (1 + 1 / m) * b
  total_se <- sqrt(total_var)

  # With U_bar = 0, the Rubin degrees of freedom reduce to m - 1.
  df <- m - 1

  alpha <- 1 - conf_level
  crit <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = df)

  tibble(
    m = m,
    Q_bar = q_bar,
    B = b,
    Total_variance = total_var,
    Total_SE = total_se,
    df = df,
    CI_95_low = q_bar - crit * total_se,
    CI_95_high = q_bar + crit * total_se
  )
}

rubin_tmt <- rubin_pool_fixed_tmt(tmt_imp_results$Estimate)

write_csv(rubin_tmt, "patternB_Rubin_TMT.csv")
print(rubin_tmt)
```

mie-pmm with 10 other data
```{r}
# MICE-PMM for Pattern B:
# Sensor 4 blackout, both directions, 10 simulated datasets

library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(lubridate)

set.seed(42)

# Global constants
M <- 5
MAXIT <- 5
TOTAL_RUNS <- 10

# Link lengths
link_miles <- c(
  S1 = 5, S2 = 5, S3 = 5, S4 = 5, S5 = 5,
  S6 = 5, S7 = 5, S8 = 5, S9 = 5, S10 = 5
)

# Time-feature function
prep <- function(dat) {

  temp_time <- parse_date_time(
    dat$Timestamp,
    orders = c("dmy HM", "dmy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS"),
    tz = "UTC"
  )

  if (any(is.na(temp_time))) {
    warning("Some timestamps could not be parsed. Check date format.")
  }

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      Timestamp = format(temp_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      Date = as.Date(temp_time),
      DayOfWeek = as.factor(as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%u")) - 1),
      Hour = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%H")),
      Minute = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%M")),
      TimeOfDay = Hour * 60 + Minute,
      Time_sin = sin(2 * pi * TimeOfDay / 1440),
      Time_cos = cos(2 * pi * TimeOfDay / 1440)
    )
}

# Lists for results from all simulated datasets
all_metrics <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)
all_comparison <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)
all_tmt_summary <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)
all_rubin_tmt <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)

for (run in seq_len(TOTAL_RUNS)) {

  cat( "STARTING MICE-PMM DATASET RUN:", run, "OUT OF", TOTAL_RUNS, "\n" )

  # Load data for this simulation run
  truth_file <- paste0("MICE_wide_1jamnew_", run, ".csv")
  miss_file <- paste0("patternB_curated_blackouts_", run, ".csv")

  truth <- read_csv(truth_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  miss <- read_csv(miss_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  truth <- prep(truth)
  miss <- prep(miss)

  original_cols <- names(miss)

  # Pattern B target variables:
  # Sensor 4, directions A and B, volume and speed
  target_vars <- c("Vol_S4_dir_a", "Spd_S4_dir_a", "Vol_S4_dir_b",  "Spd_S4_dir_b" )

  target_vars <- target_vars[target_vars %in% names(miss)]

  target_vars <- target_vars[sapply(miss[target_vars], function(x) any(is.na(x))) ]

  if (length(target_vars) == 0) {
    stop( paste("No missing values found in Pattern B variables for run",  run))
  }

  # Candidate predictors
  candidate_predictors <- c(
    "DayOfWeek", "Time_sin","Time_cos",

    "Vol_S1_dir_a", "Vol_S2_dir_a", "Vol_S3_dir_a", "Vol_S7_dir_a",
    "Spd_S1_dir_a", "Spd_S2_dir_a", "Spd_S3_dir_a", "Spd_S7_dir_a",

    "Vol_S1_dir_b", "Vol_S2_dir_b", "Vol_S3_dir_b", "Vol_S7_dir_b",
    "Spd_S1_dir_b", "Spd_S2_dir_b", "Spd_S3_dir_b", "Spd_S7_dir_b",

    "Vol_S5_dir_a", "Vol_S6_dir_a","Vol_S5_dir_b", "Vol_S6_dir_b",
    "Spd_S5_dir_a", "Spd_S6_dir_a","Spd_S5_dir_b", "Spd_S6_dir_b"
  )

  predictors <- candidate_predictors[ candidate_predictors %in% names(miss) ]

  # Remove identifier columns before MICE
  id_cols <- c("Timestamp", "Day_Name", "Date")

  id_cols <- id_cols[id_cols %in% names(miss)]

  mice_data <- miss %>%
    select(-all_of(id_cols))

  # Set up MICE
  ini <- mice(
    mice_data,
    maxit = 0,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  method <- ini$method
  method[] <- ""
  method[target_vars] <- "pmm"

  pred <- ini$predictorMatrix
  pred[,] <- 0

  for (v in target_vars) {

    pred[v, predictors[predictors %in% colnames(pred)]] <- 1

    pred[v, setdiff(target_vars, v)] <- 1

    pred[v, v] <- 0
  }

  # Run MICE-PMM
  imp <- mice(
    mice_data,
    m = M,
    maxit = MAXIT,
    method = method,
    predictorMatrix = pred,
    donors = 3,
    seed = 42 + run,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  # Create completed datasets
  completed_list <- lapply(seq_len(M), function(i) {

    dat <- complete(imp, i)

    dat <- bind_cols(miss[id_cols], dat)

    dat$Timestamp <- miss$Timestamp

    dat <- dat %>%
      select(-any_of(c( "TimeOfDay","Time_sin","Time_cos" )))

    keep_cols <- original_cols[
      !original_cols %in% c("TimeOfDay", "Time_sin", "Time_cos" )
    ]

    dat <- dat[, keep_cols]

    vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
    spd_cols <- grep("^Spd_", names(dat), value = TRUE)

    dat[vol_cols] <- lapply(dat[vol_cols],function(x) round(pmax(x, 0)) )

    dat[spd_cols] <- lapply(dat[spd_cols],function(x) round(pmax(x, 0), 1) )

    dat
  })

  # Export individual completed datasets
  for (i in seq_len(M)) {

    clean_export <- completed_list[[i]] %>%
      select(-any_of("Date"))

    write_csv(clean_export, paste0( "patternB_MICE_PMM_run",  run,"_imp",i,".csv"))
  }

  # Cellwise pooled dataset. Used for RMSE, MAE, Bias, and reconstruction plots.
  pooled <- completed_list[[1]]

  for (v in target_vars) {

    pooled[[v]] <- rowMeans(sapply(completed_list, function(d) d[[v]]),na.rm = TRUE )

    observed <- !is.na(miss[[v]])

    pooled[[v]][observed] <- miss[[v]][observed]

    if (grepl("^Vol_", v)) {
      pooled[[v]] <- round(pmax(pooled[[v]], 0))
    }

    if (grepl("^Spd_", v)) {
      pooled[[v]] <- round(pmax(pooled[[v]], 0), 1)
    }
  }

  pooled_export <- pooled %>%
    select(-any_of("Date"))

  write_csv(pooled_export,paste0("patternB_MICE_PMM_run",run,"_pooled.csv"))

  # Accuracy metrics
  calc_metrics <- function(true, pred) {

    err <- pred - true

    tibble(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean(err^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      MAE = mean(abs(err), na.rm = TRUE),
      Bias = mean(err, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }

  metrics_by_var <- bind_rows(lapply(target_vars, function(v) {

      rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

      calc_metrics(
        truth[[v]][rows],
        pooled[[v]][rows]
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          Variable = v,
          N_missing = sum(rows),
          .before = 1
        )
    })
  )

  overall_metrics <- function(cols, label) {

    cols <- cols[cols %in% target_vars]

    if (length(cols) == 0) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    temp <- bind_rows(lapply(cols, function(v) {

        rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

        tibble(
          True = truth[[v]][rows],
          Imputed = pooled[[v]][rows]
        )
      })
    )

    calc_metrics(
      temp$True,
      temp$Imputed
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Variable = label,
        N_missing = nrow(temp),
        .before = 1
      )
  }

  metrics_overall <- bind_rows(overall_metrics(
      grep("^Vol_", target_vars, value = TRUE),
      "Overall_volume"
    ),
    overall_metrics(
      grep("^Spd_", target_vars, value = TRUE),
      "Overall_speed"
    )
  )

  metrics <- bind_rows(
    metrics_by_var,
    metrics_overall
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_metrics[[run]] <- metrics

  # Missing-cell comparison table
  comparison <- bind_rows( lapply(target_vars, function(v) {

      rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

      tibble(
        Timestamp = truth$Timestamp[rows],
        Variable = v,
        GroundTruth = truth[[v]][rows],
        Missing = miss[[v]][rows],
        Imputed = pooled[[v]][rows],
        Error = pooled[[v]][rows] - truth[[v]][rows]
      )
    })
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_comparison[[run]] <- comparison

  # Total Miles Travelled
  # Each completed dataset produces one fixed realised TMT total.
  vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(miss), value = TRUE)

  sensor_name <- function(x) {
    paste0("S",sub(".*_S([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", x))
  }

  calc_tmt <- function(dat, na.rm = FALSE) {

    row_tmt <- rep(0, nrow(dat))

    for (v in vol_cols) {

      s <- sensor_name(v)

      row_tmt <- row_tmt + dat[[v]] * link_miles[[s]]
    }

    if (!na.rm && any(is.na(row_tmt))) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    sum(row_tmt, na.rm = na.rm)
  }

  # Ground-truth total for this simulation run
  tmt_truth <- calc_tmt(truth)

  # Descriptive value only. This is not used in Rubin's Rules.
  tmt_missing_observed <- calc_tmt( miss, na.rm = TRUE )

  # Cellwise pooled TMT.Retained only for descriptive comparison.
  tmt_pooled <- calc_tmt(pooled)

  # One complete-data TMT estimate per imputed dataset
  tmt_imp_results <- tibble(
    Imputation = seq_len(M),
    Estimate = vapply(
      completed_list,
      calc_tmt,
      numeric(1)
    )
  )

  tmt_summary <- tibble(
    Dataset = c("GroundTruth","Missing_observed_only","MICE_PMM_pooled",paste0("Imp", seq_len(M))
    ),
    TMT = c(
      tmt_truth,
      tmt_missing_observed,
      tmt_pooled,
      tmt_imp_results$Estimate
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_tmt_summary[[run]] <- tmt_summary

  # Rubin's Rules for the fixed realised TMT target
  # U_bar = 0.
  # Therefore, T = (1 + 1/m)B.
  rubin_pool_fixed_tmt <- function(estimates,conf_level = 0.95 ) {

    if (length(estimates) < 2) {
      stop("At least two completed datasets are required.")
    }

    if (any(!is.finite(estimates))) {
      stop("All completed datasets must have finite TMT estimates." )
    }

    m <- length(estimates)

    q_bar <- mean(estimates)

    b <- var(estimates)

    total_variance <- (1 + 1 / m) * b

    total_se <- sqrt(total_variance)

    # With U_bar = 0, degrees of freedom equal m - 1.
    df <- m - 1

    alpha <- 1 - conf_level

    crit <- qt( 1 - alpha / 2,df = df )

    tibble(
      m = m,
      Q_bar = q_bar,
      B = b,
      Total_variance = total_variance,
      Total_SE = total_se,
      df = df,
      CI_95_low = q_bar - crit * total_se,
      CI_95_high = q_bar + crit * total_se
    )
  }

  rubin_tmt <- rubin_pool_fixed_tmt(
    tmt_imp_results$Estimate
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      GroundTruth_TMT = tmt_truth,
      Signed_error = Q_bar - tmt_truth,
      Absolute_error = abs(Q_bar - tmt_truth),
      Covers_groundtruth =
        CI_95_low <= tmt_truth &
        tmt_truth <= CI_95_high,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_rubin_tmt[[run]] <- rubin_tmt
}

cat( "ALL RUNS COMPLETE. EXPORTING MASTER SUMMARY FILES.\n")

# Master accuracy metrics
master_metrics <- bind_rows(all_metrics)

write_csv( master_metrics, "patternB_MICE_PMM_MASTER_RMSE_MAE_Bias.csv")

print(master_metrics)

# Master comparison table
master_comparison <- bind_rows(all_comparison)

write_csv(master_comparison,"patternB_MICE_PMM_MASTER_groundtruth_missing_imputed.csv")

# Master TMT summary
master_tmt_summary <- bind_rows(all_tmt_summary)

write_csv(master_tmt_summary,"patternB_MICE_PMM_MASTER_TMT.csv")

print(master_tmt_summary)

# Master Rubin's Rules output
master_rubin_tmt <- bind_rows(all_rubin_tmt)

write_csv( master_rubin_tmt, "patternB_MICE_PMM_MASTER_Rubin_TMT.csv")

print(master_rubin_tmt)

# Coverage across the 10 independent simulated datasets
coverage_summary <- master_rubin_tmt %>%
  summarise(
    Total_runs = n(),
    Intervals_containing_groundtruth =
      sum(Covers_groundtruth),
    Empirical_coverage =
      mean(Covers_groundtruth),
    Mean_absolute_TMT_error =
      mean(Absolute_error),
    Mean_total_SE =
      mean(Total_SE),
    Mean_interval_width =
      mean(CI_95_high - CI_95_low)
  )

write_csv(coverage_summary,"patternB_MICE_PMM_coverage_summary.csv")

print(coverage_summary)

# Average reconstruction metrics across 10 datasets
avg_metrics <- master_metrics %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    Avg_MAE = mean(MAE),
    Avg_Bias = mean(Bias),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(avg_metrics,"patternB_MICE_PMM_average_metrics.csv")

print(avg_metrics)
```

```{r}
# Total Miles Travelled for a fixed 90-day target
# Each completed dataset produces one exact realised TMT total.
# Therefore, within-imputation variance U^(k) = 0.

vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(miss), value = TRUE)

sensor_name <- function(x) {
  paste0("S", sub(".*_S([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", x))
}

calc_tmt <- function(dat, na.rm = FALSE) {
  row_tmt <- rep(0, nrow(dat))

  for (v in vol_cols) {
    s <- sensor_name(v)
    row_tmt <- row_tmt + dat[[v]] * link_miles[[s]]
  }

  if (!na.rm && any(is.na(row_tmt))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sum(row_tmt, na.rm = na.rm)
}

# Ground-truth and descriptive totals
tmt_truth <- calc_tmt(truth)

# Descriptive value only. It is not used in Rubin's Rules.
tmt_missing_observed <- calc_tmt(miss, na.rm = TRUE)

# This is a cellwise-pooled completed dataset.Kept it for descriptive output and reconstruction metrics only.
tmt_pooled <- calc_tmt(pooled)

# Exact TMT estimate from each of the M completed datasets
tmt_imp_results <- tibble(
  Imputation = seq_len(M),
  Estimate = vapply(completed_list, calc_tmt, numeric(1))
)

# TMT summary
tmt_summary <- tibble(
  Dataset = c( "GroundTruth", "Missing_observed_only", "MICE_RF_pooled", paste0("Imp", 1:M)
  ),
  TMT = c(
    tmt_truth,
    tmt_missing_observed,
    tmt_pooled,
    tmt_imp_results$Estimate
  )
)

write_csv(tmt_summary, "patternB_MICE_RF_TMT.csv")
print(tmt_summary)


# Rubin's Rules for the fixed 90-day TMT target
# U_bar = 0, so T = (1 + 1/m)B.
rubin_pool_fixed_tmt <- function(estimates, conf_level = 0.95) {

  if (length(estimates) < 2) {
    stop("At least two imputed datasets are required.")
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(estimates))) {
    stop("All completed datasets must have finite TMT estimates.")
  }

  m <- length(estimates)

  q_bar <- mean(estimates)
  b <- var(estimates)

  total_var <- (1 + 1 / m) * b
  total_se <- sqrt(total_var)

  # With U_bar = 0, degrees of freedom reduce to m - 1.
  df <- m - 1

  alpha <- 1 - conf_level
  crit <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = df)

  tibble(
    m = m,
    Q_bar = q_bar,
    B = b,
    Total_variance = total_var,
    Total_SE = total_se,
    df = df,
    CI_95_low = q_bar - crit * total_se,
    CI_95_high = q_bar + crit * total_se
  )
}

rubin_tmt <- rubin_pool_fixed_tmt(
  tmt_imp_results$Estimate
)

write_csv(rubin_tmt, "patternB_MICE_RF_Rubin_TMT.csv")
print(rubin_tmt)
```

mice-rf with 10 other data

```{r}
# MICE-RF for Pattern B:
# Sensor 4 blackout, both directions, 10 simulated datasets

library(mice)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(randomForest)
library(lubridate)

set.seed(42)

# Global constants
M <- 5
MAXIT <- 5
RF_NTREE <- 50
TOTAL_RUNS <- 10

# Link lengths
link_miles <- c(
  S1 = 5, S2 = 5, S3 = 5, S4 = 5, S5 = 5,
  S6 = 5, S7 = 5, S8 = 5, S9 = 5, S10 = 5
)

# Time-feature function
prep <- function(dat) {

  temp_time <- parse_date_time(
    dat$Timestamp,
    orders = c("dmy HM", "dmy HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd HMS"),
    tz = "UTC"
  )

  if (any(is.na(temp_time))) {
    warning("Some timestamps could not be parsed. Check date format.")
  }

  dat %>%
    mutate(
      Timestamp = format(temp_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
      Date = as.Date(temp_time),
      DayOfWeek = as.factor(as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%u")) - 1),
      Hour = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%H")),
      Minute = as.numeric(format(temp_time, "%M")),
      TimeOfDay = Hour * 60 + Minute,
      Time_sin = sin(2 * pi * TimeOfDay / 1440),
      Time_cos = cos(2 * pi * TimeOfDay / 1440)
    )
}

# Lists for results across all simulation runs
all_metrics <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)
all_comparison <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)
all_tmt_summary <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)
all_rubin_tmt <- vector("list", TOTAL_RUNS)

for (run in seq_len(TOTAL_RUNS)) {

  cat( "STARTING MICE-RF DATASET RUN:", run, "OUT OF", TOTAL_RUNS, "\n" )

  # Load data for this simulation run
  truth_file <- paste0("MICE_wide_1jamnew_", run, ".csv")
  miss_file <- paste0("patternB_curated_blackouts_", run, ".csv")

  truth <- read_csv(truth_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  miss <- read_csv(miss_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

  truth <- prep(truth)
  miss <- prep(miss)

  original_cols <- names(miss)

  # Pattern B target variables:
  # Sensor 4, both directions, volume and speed
  target_vars <- c(
    "Vol_S4_dir_a", "Spd_S4_dir_a", "Vol_S4_dir_b", "Spd_S4_dir_b")

  target_vars <- target_vars[target_vars %in% names(miss)]

  target_vars <- target_vars[sapply(miss[target_vars], function(x) any(is.na(x)))]

  if (length(target_vars) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No missing values found in Pattern B variables for run",run))
  }

  # Candidate predictors
  candidate_predictors <- c(
    "DayOfWeek","Time_sin","Time_cos",

    "Vol_S1_dir_a", "Vol_S2_dir_a", "Vol_S3_dir_a", "Vol_S7_dir_a",
    "Spd_S1_dir_a", "Spd_S2_dir_a", "Spd_S3_dir_a", "Spd_S7_dir_a",

    "Vol_S1_dir_b", "Vol_S2_dir_b", "Vol_S3_dir_b", "Vol_S7_dir_b",
    "Spd_S1_dir_b", "Spd_S2_dir_b", "Spd_S3_dir_b", "Spd_S7_dir_b",

    "Vol_S5_dir_a", "Vol_S6_dir_a","Vol_S5_dir_b", "Vol_S6_dir_b",
    "Spd_S5_dir_a", "Spd_S6_dir_a", "Spd_S5_dir_b", "Spd_S6_dir_b"
  )

  predictors <- candidate_predictors[candidate_predictors %in% names(miss)]

  # Remove identifier columns before MICE
  id_cols <- c("Timestamp", "Day_Name", "Date")

  id_cols <- id_cols[id_cols %in% names(miss)]

  mice_data <- miss %>%
    select(-all_of(id_cols))

  # MICE setup
  ini <- mice(
    mice_data,
    maxit = 0,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  method <- ini$method
  method[] <- ""
  method[target_vars] <- "rf"

  pred <- ini$predictorMatrix
  pred[,] <- 0

  for (v in target_vars) {

    pred[v, predictors[predictors %in% colnames(pred)]] <- 1

    pred[v, setdiff(target_vars, v)] <- 1

    pred[v, v] <- 0
  }

  # Run MICE-RF
  imp <- mice(
    mice_data,
    m = M,
    maxit = MAXIT,
    method = method,
    predictorMatrix = pred,
    ntree = RF_NTREE,
    seed = 42 + run,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  # Create completed datasets
  completed_list <- lapply(seq_len(M), function(i) {

    dat <- complete(imp, i)

    dat <- bind_cols(miss[id_cols], dat)

    dat$Timestamp <- miss$Timestamp

    dat <- dat %>%
      select(-any_of(c(  "TimeOfDay",  "Time_sin",  "Time_cos"  )))

    keep_cols <- original_cols[
      !original_cols %in% c( "TimeOfDay", "Time_sin", "Time_cos"  )
    ]

    dat <- dat[, keep_cols]

    vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(dat), value = TRUE)
    spd_cols <- grep("^Spd_", names(dat), value = TRUE)

    dat[vol_cols] <- lapply( dat[vol_cols], function(x) round(pmax(x, 0)) )

    dat[spd_cols] <- lapply(dat[spd_cols],function(x) round(pmax(x, 0), 1) )

    dat
  })

  # Export individual imputed datasets
  for (i in seq_len(M)) {

    clean_export <- completed_list[[i]] %>%
      select(-any_of("Date"))

    write_csv(clean_export,paste0(  "patternB_MICE_RF_run",  run,  "_imp",  i,  ".csv")  )
  }

  # Cellwise pooled dataset
  # Used for reconstruction metrics and visualisations.
  pooled <- completed_list[[1]]

  for (v in target_vars) {

    pooled[[v]] <- rowMeans(sapply(completed_list, function(d) d[[v]]),na.rm = TRUE)

    observed <- !is.na(miss[[v]])

    pooled[[v]][observed] <- miss[[v]][observed]

    if (grepl("^Vol_", v)) {
      pooled[[v]] <- round(pmax(pooled[[v]], 0))
    }

    if (grepl("^Spd_", v)) {
      pooled[[v]] <- round(pmax(pooled[[v]], 0), 1)
    }
  }

  pooled_export <- pooled %>%
    select(-any_of("Date"))

  write_csv( pooled_export, paste0( "patternB_MICE_RF_run", run,"_pooled.csv" ))

  # Accuracy metrics
  calc_metrics <- function(true, pred) {

    err <- pred - true

    tibble(
      RMSE = sqrt(mean(err^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      MAE = mean(abs(err), na.rm = TRUE),
      Bias = mean(err, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }

  metrics_by_var <- bind_rows(apply(target_vars, function(v) {

      rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

      calc_metrics(
        truth[[v]][rows],
        pooled[[v]][rows]
      ) %>%
        mutate(
          Variable = v,
          N_missing = sum(rows),
          .before = 1
        )
    })
  )

  overall_metrics <- function(cols, label) {

    cols <- cols[cols %in% target_vars]

    if (length(cols) == 0) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    temp <- bind_rows(lapply(cols, function(v) {

        rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

        tibble(
          True = truth[[v]][rows],
          Imputed = pooled[[v]][rows]
        )
      })
    )

    calc_metrics(
      temp$True,
      temp$Imputed
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        Variable = label,
        N_missing = nrow(temp),
        .before = 1
      )
  }

  metrics_overall <- bind_rows(
    overall_metrics(
      grep("^Vol_", target_vars, value = TRUE),
      "Overall_volume"
    ),
    overall_metrics(
      grep("^Spd_", target_vars, value = TRUE),
      "Overall_speed"
    )
  )

  metrics <- bind_rows(
    metrics_by_var,
    metrics_overall
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_metrics[[run]] <- metrics

  # Missing-cell comparison table
  comparison <- bind_rows(lapply(target_vars, function(v) {

      rows <- is.na(miss[[v]]) & !is.na(truth[[v]])

      tibble(
        Timestamp = truth$Timestamp[rows],
        Variable = v,
        GroundTruth = truth[[v]][rows],
        Missing = miss[[v]][rows],
        Imputed = pooled[[v]][rows],
        Error = pooled[[v]][rows] - truth[[v]][rows]
      )
    })
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_comparison[[run]] <- comparison

  # Total Miles Travelled
  # Each completed dataset produces one fixed realised TMT total.
  vol_cols <- grep("^Vol_", names(miss), value = TRUE)

  sensor_name <- function(x) {
    paste0( "S",sub(".*_S([0-9]+)_.*", "\\1", x))
  }

  calc_tmt <- function(dat, na.rm = FALSE) {

    row_tmt <- rep(0, nrow(dat))

    for (v in vol_cols) {

      s <- sensor_name(v)

      row_tmt <- row_tmt + dat[[v]] * link_miles[[s]]
    }

    if (!na.rm && any(is.na(row_tmt))) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    sum(row_tmt, na.rm = na.rm)
  }

  # Ground-truth TMT for this simulation run
  tmt_truth <- calc_tmt(truth)

  # Descriptive value only.
  # It is not used in Rubin's Rules.
  tmt_missing_observed <- calc_tmt( miss, na.rm = TRUE )

  # Cellwise pooled TMT.
  # Retained only for descriptive comparison.
  tmt_pooled <- calc_tmt(pooled)

  # One complete-data TMT total per imputed dataset
  tmt_imp_results <- tibble(
    Imputation = seq_len(M),
    Estimate = vapply(
      completed_list,
      calc_tmt,
      numeric(1)
    )
  )

  tmt_summary <- tibble(
    Dataset = c("GroundTruth","Missing_observed_only","MICE_RF_pooled",paste0("Imp", seq_len(M))
    ),
    TMT = c(
      tmt_truth,
      tmt_missing_observed,
      tmt_pooled,
      tmt_imp_results$Estimate
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_tmt_summary[[run]] <- tmt_summary

  # Rubin's Rules for a fixed realised 90-day TMT target
  # U_bar = 0.
  # Therefore, T = (1 + 1/m)B.
  rubin_pool_fixed_tmt <- function(estimates,conf_level = 0.95) {

    if (length(estimates) < 2) {
      stop("At least two completed datasets are required.")
    }

    if (any(!is.finite(estimates))) {
      stop( "All completed datasets must have finite TMT estimates.")
    }

    m <- length(estimates)

    q_bar <- mean(estimates)

    b <- var(estimates)

    total_variance <- (1 + 1 / m) * b

    total_se <- sqrt(total_variance)

    # With U_bar = 0, degrees of freedom equal m - 1.
    df <- m - 1

    alpha <- 1 - conf_level

    crit <- qt( 1 - alpha / 2, df = df)

    tibble(
      m = m,
      Q_bar = q_bar,
      B = b,
      Total_variance = total_variance,
      Total_SE = total_se,
      df = df,
      CI_95_low = q_bar - crit * total_se,
      CI_95_high = q_bar + crit * total_se
    )
  }

  rubin_tmt <- rubin_pool_fixed_tmt(
    tmt_imp_results$Estimate
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Dataset_Run = run,
      GroundTruth_TMT = tmt_truth,
      Signed_error = Q_bar - tmt_truth,
      Absolute_error = abs(Q_bar - tmt_truth),
      Covers_groundtruth =
        CI_95_low <= tmt_truth &
        tmt_truth <= CI_95_high,
      .before = 1
    )

  all_rubin_tmt[[run]] <- rubin_tmt
}

cat("ALL RUNS COMPLETE. EXPORTING MASTER SUMMARY FILES.\n")

# Master accuracy metrics
master_metrics <- bind_rows(all_metrics)

write_csv(master_metrics,"patternB_MICE_RF_MASTER_RMSE_MAE_Bias.csv")

print(master_metrics)

# Master missing-cell comparison table
master_comparison <- bind_rows(all_comparison)

write_csv(master_comparison,"patternB_MICE_RF_MASTER_groundtruth_missing_imputed.csv")

# Master TMT summary
master_tmt_summary <- bind_rows(all_tmt_summary)

write_csv(master_tmt_summary,"patternB_MICE_RF_MASTER_TMT.csv")

print(master_tmt_summary)

# Master Rubin's Rules output
master_rubin_tmt <- bind_rows(all_rubin_tmt)

write_csv(master_rubin_tmt,"patternB_MICE_RF_MASTER_Rubin_TMT.csv")

print(master_rubin_tmt)

# Coverage across the 10 independent simulated datasets
coverage_summary <- master_rubin_tmt %>%
  summarise(
    Total_runs = n(),
    Intervals_containing_groundtruth =
      sum(Covers_groundtruth),
    Empirical_coverage =
      mean(Covers_groundtruth),
    Mean_absolute_TMT_error =
      mean(Absolute_error),
    Mean_total_SE =
      mean(Total_SE),
    Mean_interval_width =
      mean(CI_95_high - CI_95_low)
  )

write_csv(coverage_summary,"patternB_MICE_RF_coverage_summary.csv")

print(coverage_summary)

# Average reconstruction metrics across the 10 datasets
avg_metrics <- master_metrics %>%
  group_by(Variable) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
    Avg_MAE = mean(MAE),
    Avg_Bias = mean(Bias),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write_csv(avg_metrics,"patternB_MICE_RF_average_metrics.csv")

print(avg_metrics)
```
